summary.text: 旁 commonly means “side,” “beside,” or “near.” Its traditional analysis identifies 方 as a sound element, but the other element’s identity and contribution remain unresolved.

formation.text: The graph is analyzed as containing 方, which the traditional dictionary identifies as a sound element. Early forms are also described as 方 combined with an unidentified element, for which 凡 is one proposal. Since that element’s identity and meaning contribution are unsettled, a phonosemantic analysis remains a proposal rather than a secure formation classification.

components.text: 方 is identified as the sound element in the traditional analysis. In the supplied Baxter–Sagart forms, 方 *paŋ and 旁 *[b]ˤaŋ share a rhyme but differ in initial notation; 方 also has multiple listed lexical readings. This comparison is compatible with the proposed role but does not settle its historical details.

sound_limitation.text: The supplied historical comparison shows rhyme compatibility, but does not by itself establish the precise sound relationship or the component’s role.

sound.text: The forms share the rhyme but differ in initial notation; 方 has multiple listed lexical entries in this system.
The Mandarin readings share the final -ang but have different initials; this modern comparison does not establish their ancient relationship.

history.text: Historical dictionary records list 𣃟 and 𣃙 as ancient-script forms and 雱 as a Zhou-script form. A Chu silk-script form is also recorded. These forms do not establish a stroke-by-stroke sequence or resolve the identity of the other element.

Early inscription uses are reported in place, polity, and personal names, as well as in a Spring-and-Autumn directional expression read as 方. These uses do not establish that the common sense “side” was already present.
The Shuowen account glosses 旁 as 溥 and marks an element’s explanation as 闕. The authorship and referent of that note are disputed; one reported view treats it as a result of graphic change.

uncertainties.text: The other element’s identity and contribution remain unresolved. A reduced 凡 has been proposed, alongside other identifications, but its original form and role are not settled.
The first use of 旁 meaning “side” or “near” is not dated here. No development from 溥, interpreted in later commentary as “broad” or “abundant,” to “side” is established.

senses.text: 旁 is used with the meanings “side,” “beside,” and “near.” Early manuscript examples are reported, but the first occurrence of these meanings is not dated here.
The traditional dictionary glosses 旁 as 溥; later commentary interprets this as “broad” or “abundant.” This account does not establish the graph’s original meaning.

limitations.text: No dated semantic link is established between the traditional gloss 溥 (“broad” or “abundant”) and the common meanings “side” or “near.” The reported early name and directional uses do not establish that link either.
